parent_session.title: 讨论目标客户与GPT Image后端接入

part.text:
对以下三张移动端测试结果页截图做视觉验收。它们是一个"测试工坊"的三种产品形态 demo（同一品牌 MYTHIC），目标用户是小红书上的年轻女性/年轻用户，设计目标是"有设计感、像可以被晒图分享的精品质感"，不是普通后台页面。

请逐张评审（每张都检查以下维度）：
1. 视觉锚点是否清晰（第一眼看到什么？是否符合该形态的卖点：01 是原型结果卡的氛围感，03 是动物结果的对称仪式感，04 是大数字指数的冲击力）
2. 排版问题：文字溢出、对齐错乱、间距失衡、对比度不足（深色底上的可读性）
3. 色彩：强调色是否协调、有无刺眼或脏色
4. 组件质感：卡片/徽章/进度条是否精致（而非粗糙默认样式）
5. 作为"晒图分享"的画面是否成立（用户愿意截图发小红书吗）

截图路径：
- /tmp/demo-shots/01-archetype-result.png （深夜便利店·原型加权，结果卡）
- /tmp/demo-shots/03-choice2-result.png （夜行动物·30秒二选一，结果卡）
- /tmp/demo-shots/04-index-result.png （内耗指数·指数分档，大数字结果页）

对每张图返回一行 JSON 判定：{"file":"...","verdict":"pass|fail","issues":["具体问题+位置"]}。issues 为空数组表示通过。最后给一段总体判断：三张里最弱的是哪张、最该改什么（只说结论级建议，不用给代码）。
Let me read the three screenshots one by one and evaluate them against the criteria.

Let me analyze each screenshot carefully.

**01-archetype-result.png (原型加权·深夜便利店)**
- Visual anchor: Giant character "关" in white serif, then "关东煮型" in orange/gold, on a warm amber glow gradient. This creates atmosphere — the warm gradient from top feels like convenience store light at night. The anchor is clear: the big "关" character with warm glow.
- Typography: Large "关" white serif — striking. "关东煮型" orange. Tagline "一锅慢火，暖的是别人也暖了自己" in white. Tags (温暖/照料/慢火) outlined pill badges with orange text. Body text white on dark — readable. Quote at bottom with orange left border, orange serif text.
- Layout: header area with title "三种产品形态，都能长成什么样", tabs/chips at top (原型加权·深夜便利店 active in cream pill; other two inactive). Result card has warm gradient top fading into dark navy.
- Issues? The giant "关" overlaps... it sits at top of card, "关东煮型" below. There's a slight concern: the huge "关" character with the second line "关东煮型" — the "关" appears alone and then repeats as first char of 关东煮型. That's a design choice (drop cap style). Fine.
- Contrast: The header subtitle "同一套引擎·同一套质量门·三种设计语言 —— 数据来自真实骨架包" is gray on dark, somewhat low contrast but it's a page header for demo context, not part of the deliverable card itself? Actually the whole image is the deliverable page. The gray subtitle is dim but readable-ish. "RESULT" label orange, "MYTHIC 便利店 · 深夜营业中" right side orange — fine.
- The bottom of the image has a lot of empty dark space below the card (card ends ~1310px, image is 1688px tall). There's a large empty area at bottom. Is that imbalance? The card region is a phone-frame-like container that extends to bottom; the card content ends but the outer container continues with dark empty space. Hmm, looking at the image: the outer rounded container starts ~430px and continues to bottom edge; the inner card ends at ~1310, leaving ~370px of dark empty space at the bottom. That's noticeable dead space. Same on 03 and 04 — consistent across all three, so it may be a container padding issue common to all. Is it a defect? "visible imbalance" — a large empty dark area at the bottom of each page. Since it's consistent across all three, it reads as the card just being shorter than the viewport/container. For a mobile screenshot meant for sharing, the trailing empty space makes the composition less tight, but it's dark-on-dark and not egregious. I'd note it maybe on the weakest one only. Let me compare.

01: card ends ~1310/1688 → ~380px empty. Actually the outer container边框 visible till bottom. The empty space below the inner card within the outer rounded frame.

03: card ends ~1360/1688 → ~330px empty.

04: card ends ~1355/1688 → ~330px empty.

Similar in all. Hmm.

For 01, other checks:
- Body text: white on dark, good contrast.
- Quote: orange serif on dark with left orange bar — refined.
- Badges: outlined pills with orange border — fine, not default-looking.
- The warm glow gradient: top of card is bright amber fading down. The "关" white on bright amber area — white on light amber... The "关" is white/cream on a fairly bright warm gradient. Contrast might be reduced but the glow dims quickly; the 关 is at the brighter zone. Looking at the image, "关" is cream-white on medium amber — readable enough, it's large. Slight risk but acceptable.
- Overall atmosphere: yes, feels like "深夜便利店" warmth. Shareable? Yes, quite.

One more: tabs row — "原型加权·深夜便利店" active cream pill, second "30 秒二选一·夜行动物" inactive dark. Third row "指数分档·内耗指数" on its own line centered. The first two chips are on one row, third wraps to a second row. The wrapping makes the third chip centered while first two are left-aligned-ish (actually they look centered as a group). Row 1 has two chips, row 2 has one centered chip. It's a wrap layout, acceptable but slightly awkward? It's consistent across all three screenshots (same header). Since it's identical in all three, it's the demo page header. Chips centered: row1 appears to span full width with two chips; row2 single chip centered. Fine.

Verdict 01: pass. Maybe minor: giant "关" is white on the brightest part of gradient — contrast slightly reduced but legible. I won't fail for that. Actually, is there any overlap between the big "关" and anything? No.

Wait — one potential issue: "关" big char and below "关东煮型" — the big char's vertical spacing is fine.

I'll pass 01. Possibly note the subtitle gray contrast. The reporting rules: report an issue only when concrete. The gray subtitle "同一套引擎..." on near-black: it's mid-gray, small text — borderline. It's readable in the screenshot. I'll not report.

**03-choice2-result.png (夜行动物)**
- Visual anchor: golden crescent moon, "飞蛾型" in mint green serif, centered symmetric layout. The dispatch says 03's selling point is "动物结果的对称仪式感" (symmetric ritual feel). The layout: moon icon centered, title centered, tagline centered, three badges centered, body text... wait, the body text "你受不了安静的黑..." is left-aligned while everything else is centered. Hmm — body paragraph is left-aligned (justified?), which is normal for paragraphs. The quote at bottom "哪里有光，哪就有我。" centered with divider lines above and below. The symmetry mostly holds.
- Issue: The body text alignment — first line "你受不了安静的黑，哪里亮堂就往哪里飞。" ends and line 2 "夜里的热闹是你的充电器——只是偶尔也挑一" line 3 "盏不烫的灯。" — the last line is short, left aligned. That's normal paragraph rag. Fine.
- Colors: gold moon + mint green title + mint badges. Gold and mint together — is it coordinated? Gold crescent with mint text... it's a night/moth theme; gold moon + cool mint could be intentional (light vs night). Does it look harmonious? The moon is quite saturated yellow/gold with a glow; mint green text. It's okay-ish. Hmm, gold+teal is a valid combo. The title "飞蛾型" mint green serif — fine.
- The badge outlines mint with mint text — fine.
- Quote mint serif italic-ish with horizontal rules above/below — clean, symmetric ritual feel. Good.
- Any layout issue? The card ends after quote divider ~1360. Bottom empty space ~330px as noted.
- One thing: the moon image — is it an emoji-style crescent? It looks like a rendered golden crescent with glow, slightly 3D/emoji-like. Is that "crude improvised graphic"? It looks like a polished emoji-grade crescent 🌙 actually. It has gradient shading, looks like the 🌙 emoji rendered large. For "精品质感" an emoji as the hero visual might feel cheap... but it's clean and glowing, on-theme. It reads as deliberate. Hmm. It does look quite like the Apple emoji moon. For a premium feel target, an emoji hero is borderline. But it's sharp, centered, with glow — I'd call it a design choice, not a defect. The criteria say stylized treatments are design choices. And "组件质感...粗糙默认样式" — an emoji is somewhat default. But I can't definitively call it an emoji; it could be a custom SVG. It's smooth with gradient. I'll not fail on it; maybe mention as minor? Rules say report only concrete problems. "Looks like an emoji" is a subjective judgment. I'll leave 03 pass but this is possibly the weakest? Let me check 04 first.

- Contrast: body white on dark green-navy, good. Tagline "哪里有光，就往哪里去" white, good.
- 03 verdict: pass. Maybe minor imbalance: card interior — bottom quote area has divider lines extending nearly full card width, symmetric. Good.

**04-index-result.png (内耗指数)**
- Visual anchor: giant "36" in white serif — very large, centered. Strong impact. Progress bar below showing ~36% filled in light blue.
- Then a sub-card "漂移档" in light blue, tagline "偶尔想多，但能自己拉回来", body text.
- Issue check: The big "36" — does it overlap the progress bar? The progress bar sits right below the numerals; the "36" descenders (the 3 and 6 in serif) — the "6" bottom... The bar is at y~895, the "36" spans ~650-880. Looks close but no overlap.
- Wait, look closely: the "3" glyph's bottom appears to nearly touch the progress bar? The bar spans x 150-700, the "36" is centered ~280-590. The bar left segment (filled blue) is x150-355. The "36" bottom edge ~880, bar at ~890. Tight spacing but no overlap visible.
- Progress bar: thin rounded bar, ~36% filled light blue. For "36" score... if the index is 内耗指数 36, then a 36% fill makes sense. Fine.
- Tier card "漂移档" — light blue/periwinkle accent on dark navy-purple. Body text white, readable. Card has border, rounded corners. Fine.
- Hmm, one thing: score 36 → "漂移档" (drift tier) with description "偶尔想多，但能自己拉回来" — plausible mapping (36 is low-mid).
- Colors: header "MYTHIC 指数所" in purple/violet; "漂移档" in periwinkle blue; progress bar blue. Slight mix of purple and blue — coherent cool palette. OK.
- The empty space below card again ~330px.
- The big 36: white serif with subtle glow — strong. Good impact.
- Anything off? The label "精神内耗指数" letter-spaced above the number — good. 
- Balance: The number is slightly left of center? "36" centered around x~430; canvas 860 wide → center 430. Looks centered.
- Progress bar fill ratio: fill ends at ~355 of 150-700 → (355-150)/(700-150) = 205/550 ≈ 37%. Matches 36. Good — chart accuracy.
- 04 verdict: pass.

Now overall: which is weakest? Comparing:
- 01 has strong atmosphere, warm gradient, refined quote block. Its "关" hero + orange is distinctive.
- 03 has symmetric ritual, moon + mint. The moon glyph looks emoji-like; also gold+mint combination is slightly less cohesive? Also the body text left-aligned vs otherwise centered — minor.
- 04 has big number impact, clean.

Hmm. Actually let me reconsider 01's issues. The subtitle gray text "同一套引擎·同一套质量门·三种设计语言 —— 数据来自真实骨架包" — contrast is low-ish gray on black. Same on all three. Not a per-page differentiator.

01: the giant "关" — white on the bright amber glow region. Looking again at the image: the glow is brightest at the top center, and "关" is at x~200,y~630 which is... the gradient at that point is mid-amber, and the glyph is cream/white. Contrast is adequate for a huge glyph. Fine.

01 potential issue: "关" and "关东煮型" — the giant character duplicates the first character. Some may see redundancy but it's a typographic device. OK.

Which is weakest? Let me weigh "晒图分享" appeal:
- 01: warm, emotional, distinctive — strong for sharing.
- 04: big number is instantly shareable ("我的内耗指数36") — strong.
- 03: the moon emoji look + gold/mint mix makes it feel slightly more like a template; also the card content: title 飞蛾型 mint green — the green is a bit light/neon? The mint used for title and badges — looks like a soft green #7fd. It's fine.

Honestly, differences are small. Candidate for weakest: 03 — because (a) hero visual (crescent) reads as a stock emoji rather than custom art, reducing "精品质感"; (b) gold moon vs mint text is a two-accent combo that's less unified than 01's single warm accent and 04's cool accent. Also body paragraph left-ragged under a fully centered composition slightly breaks the "对称仪式感" — actually paragraphs left-aligned is fine.

Hmm wait, let me look at 03 again more carefully. The quote section: there's a horizontal rule, then quote, then horizontal rule below near card bottom. The bottom rule is at ~1310, card ends ~1360. Fine.

Also in 03, the moon sits with generous top padding — balanced.

One more check on 04: The tier card's inner spacing — "漂移档" title, tagline, body. The card bottom padding ~1355-1300 fine.

Empty bottom space across all three: ~330-380px of near-empty dark container below cards. Should I report it? It's consistent, dark-on-dark; for a phone-frame demo this is like the page continues. As "visible imbalance" — the card doesn't fill the container, leaving a dark void at bottom of every screenshot. Given it's uniform across all three, it's a systemic layout trait. Per rules, report concrete problems. A ~20% empty dark tail at the bottom — for screenshots meant for sharing, users would crop anyway. I think it's worth one Design note on... hmm. If I report on all three, all three would still pass? No — any criterion violated → fail. Is it a violation? "modules crammed" no; "one side overloaded while other empty" — vertical dead space at bottom is common in scrolling pages; this is a full-page screenshot of a scrollable page, likely content continues (e.g., CTA below the fold?). Actually these are result pages; below the card there could be a "重新测试" button that's below the fold in capture. The capture includes it as empty. Given ambiguity and that it's dark-on-dark, I won't fail for it; it's marginal. But per "report an issue only when you can state the concrete problem" — the concrete problem is "卡片下方有大片空黑区域". It is visible. Hmm, but is it a defect or just page background? The outer container (rounded frame) extends to image bottom edge — this looks like a phone mockup frame that's taller than content. The verdicts: I'd call it minor and consistent; fail-worthy? No. I'll mention it as the systemic note in the overall summary instead of failing any page.

Actually wait — should I reconsider whether any page should fail? Let me scrutinize once more.

01: Any text overflow? "关东煮型" fits. Tags fit. Body text: 4 lines, fits. Quote fits within borders. Right side "MYTHIC 便利店 · 深夜营业中" fits. Pass.

03: "飞蛾型" fits. Badges fit. Body 3 lines fit. Pass.

04: "36" huge, fits. Bar fits. Card fits. Pass.

All pass. Weakest: 03. Recommendation: replace emoji-like crescent with custom illustrated hero or unify accent (either gold-led or mint-led), strengthen the "对称仪式感".

Hmm, actually let me double check 03's moon: it's a golden crescent with smooth gradient — honestly could be a nicely rendered SVG with radial gradient. It has a soft outer glow. It looks pretty decent. But compared to 01's typographic hero and 04's big-number hero, 03's moon is the least distinctive, and gold+mint dual accent is the least unified palette. I'll go with 03 as weakest, with conclusion-level advice.

Wait, also check 03 for the header chips: "30 秒二选一 · 夜行动物" is the active cream pill. Consistent with 03's content. Good — each screenshot correctly highlights its own tab (01 highlights 原型加权, 04 highlights 指数分档). Good consistency.

Cross-slide consistency: headers identical across three, active tab changes correctly. RESULT label color changes per theme (orange/mint/purple) — intentional per-format design language ("三种设计语言"). Good.

Now output format: The user asked for one JSON line per image: {"file":"...","verdict":"pass|fail","issues":[...]}. Note the user's format uses "file" not "page". Follow the user's requested format. Then a short overall judgment paragraph.

Per my system prompt output rules it says one JSON line per page with "page" — but the dispatch explicitly defines the format with "file". The dispatch takes precedence for keys. I'll output in the requested format.

Final answer:

{"file":"/tmp/demo-shots/01-archetype-result.png","verdict":"pass","issues":[]}
{"file":"/tmp/demo-shots/03-choice2-result.png","verdict":"pass","issues":[]}
{"file":"/tmp/demo-shots/04-index-result.png","verdict":"pass","issues":[]}

Should 03 have a minor issue listed while still passing? The format implies issues accompany fail. If issues non-empty but verdict pass, confusing. Keep empty.

Hmm, but let me reconsider whether 03 deserves a fail. Criteria: "组件质感：卡片/徽章/进度条是否精致（而非粗糙默认样式）" — the moon as hero: if it is literally the 🌙 emoji, that's a "crude improvised graphic" / default asset. Let me look at the image again... The crescent has smooth shading, highlight on upper limb, darker inner edge, warm gold, with soft glow halo. Apple's 🌙 crescent moon emoji is gold with similar shading. This looks very much like it could be the emoji at large size, but it also has a glow behind it that's added. At this resolution I can't definitively say it's an emoji. Rule: "What you cannot confirm, mark Unverified." That would apply to claiming it's an emoji. I won't fail on speculation. So 03 passes.

Overall judgment: weakest is 03; most worth changing: hero asset distinctiveness + palette unification (gold moon vs mint text is two accent systems), e.g., mint-led monochrome with a custom line-art moth/moon, to match the polish of 01/04. Also mention the systemic bottom dead space (all three have ~1/5 empty dark tail under the card) — worth tightening for screenshot framing. And maybe note 01's white "关" sits on the brightest gradient zone (contrast slightly compressed) as second-priority tweak? Keep conclusion-level, brief.
